CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: filterQuery
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Gets or sets the filter query to pass to CKAN when querying the available data sources and their groups. Each item in the
array causes an independent request to the CKAN, and the results are concatenated.  The
search string is equivalent to what would be in the parameters segment of the url calling the CKAN search api.
See the Solr documentation for information about filter queries.
Each item is an object ({ fq: 'res_format:wms' }). For robustness sake, a query string is also allowed. E.g.
"fq=(res_format:wms OR res_format:WMS)" and "fq=+(res_format%3Awms%20OR%20res_format%3AWMS)" are allowed.
- To get all the datasets with wms resources: [{ fq: 'res_format%3awms' }]
- To get all wms/WMS datasets in the Surface Water group: [{q: 'groups=Surface Water', fq: 'res_format:WMS' }]
- To get both wms and esri-mapService datasets: [{q: 'res_format:WMS'}, {q: 'res_format:"Esri REST"' }]
- To get all datasets with no filter, you can use ['']

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: groupBy
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating how datasets should be grouped.  Valid values are:
* none - Datasets are put in a flat list; they are not grouped at all.
* group - Datasets are grouped according to their CKAN group.  Datasets that are not in any groups are put at the top level.
* organization - Datasets are grouped by their CKAN organization.  Datasets that are not associated with an organization are put at the top level.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: ungroupedTitle
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description:
A title for the group holding all items that don't have a group in CKAN.
If the value is a blank string or undefined, these items will be left at the top level, not grouped.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: allowEntireWmsServers
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: True to allow entire WMS servers (that is, WMS resources without a clearly-defined layer) to be added to the catalog; otherwise, false.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: excludeInactiveDatasets
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: True to remove inactive datasets. Where state = "deleted" (CKAN official), state === "draft" (CKAN official) or data_state === "inactive" (Data.gov.au CKAN).

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: resourceIdTemplate
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: A Mustache formatted template string for generating a custom resource id from resource description. By default we use resource.id as the ID of the CKAN item but some CKAN services change their resource IDs frequently which can break terria features link share links or catalog search indexing. You can use customResourceIdTemplate to instruct terria to construct a different ID instead of the default resource.id. The template string will receive the entire resource as a template variable. Example usage: '{{resource.name}}-{{resource.format}}'.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: restrictResourceIdTemplateToOrgsWithNames
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Names of organisations for which customResourceIdTemplate should be used.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: name
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The name of the catalog item.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: description
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: If true, then no generic default description will be displayed if description is undefined.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: nameInCatalog
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The name of the item to be displayed in the catalog, if it is different from the one to display in the workbench.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: info
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Human-readable information about this dataset.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: infoSectionOrder
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: shortReport
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: shortReportSections
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: isExperiencingIssues
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideSource
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: metadataUrls
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: dataUrls
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: dataCustodian
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: modelDimensions
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: disableAboutData
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: shareable
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: useResourceName
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: True to use the name of the resource for the name of the catalog item; false to use the name of the dataset.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: useDatasetNameAndFormatWhereMultipleResources
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Use a combination of the name and the resource format and dataset where there are multiple resources for a single dataset.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: useCombinationNameWhereMultipleResources
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Use a combination of the name and the resource and dataset name where there are multiple resources for a single dataset.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: supportedResourceFormats
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The supported distribution formats and their mapping to Terria types. These are listed in order of preference.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: useSingleResource
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Only use a single resource for each dataset. If multiple resources exist, the highest match from supportedResourceFormats will be used. If this is true, then useDatasetNameAndFormatWhereMultipleResources and useCombinationNameWhereMultipleResources will be ignored

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: excludeMembers
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: An array of strings of excluded group and item names (or ids). A group or item name (or id) that appears in this list will not be shown to the user. This is case-insensitive and will also apply to all child/nested groups

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: includeMembersRegex
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: A regular expression that is matched against the member names and ids. Only members (groups and items) that match against the regular expression will be shown to the user. This is case-insensitive and will only apply to the first level of members (not in nested groups). This is applied before excludeMembers.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: isOpen
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: True if this group is open and its contents are visible; otherwise, false.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: mergeGroupsByName
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Merge member groups by name.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: sortMembersBy
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Sort members by the given property/trait. For example name, will sort all members by alphabetically

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: members
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The members of this group.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: displayGroup
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Allow adding all members to the workbench with one click. Show Add All / Remove All button

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemProperties
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items (note - will not set traits to sub-groups). This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Also see itemPropertiesByType and itemPropertiesByIds.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemPropertiesByType
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items by model type (eg csv or geojson). This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Only one itemProperties can be specified per type.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemPropertiesByIds
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items by model ID. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Only one itemProperties can be specified per id.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: legends
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The legends to display on the workbench.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: legendBackgroundColor
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Apply background color to all legends. This can be useful if legends are transparent and clash with Terria colours

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideLegendInWorkbench
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the legend is hidden in the workbench for this catalog member.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: url
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: forceProxy
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

CkanCatalogGroupTraits.name: cacheDuration
CkanCatalogGroupTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

InfoSectionTraits.name: content
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section, in Markdown and HTML format. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: url
MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL

DataUrlTraits.name: url
DataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

DataUrlTraits.name: title
DataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DimensionOptionTraits.name: value
DimensionOptionTraits.description: Value (if this is undefined, id will be used)

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: id
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: The ID of this distribution format.

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: formatRegex
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: A regular expression that is matched against the distribution's format. This must be defined for this format to be used

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: urlRegex
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: A regular expression that is matched against the url, this will only be used if formatRegex matches.

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: maxFileSize
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: The maximum allowed file size for this format (in megabytes).

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: onlyUseIfSoleResource
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: This resource will only match if no other resource types match for a given dataset. Like a "last-resort" resource. This will be ignored if useSingleResource is used

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: removeDuplicates
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: Remove resources if they have the same name. If duplicates are found, then the newest resource will be used (according to created property). This is applied per format

CkanResourceFormatTraits.name: definition
CkanResourceFormatTraits.description: The catalog member definition to use when the URL and Format regular expressions match. The URL property will also be set.

ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.name: type
ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.description: The type of model to apply itemProperties to. This must be defined.

ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.name: itemProperties
ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.description: Sets traits on group member items of specified type. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups)

ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.name: ids
ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.description: The IDs of models to apply itemProperties to.

ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.name: itemProperties
ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.description: Sets traits on group member items of specified id. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups)

LegendTraits.name: title
LegendTraits.description: A title to be displayed above the legend.

LegendTraits.name: url
LegendTraits.description: The URL of the legend image. If the URL suffix isn't one of the following png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg, then urlMimeType must be defined - otherwise a hyperlink will be shown.

LegendTraits.name: imageScaling
LegendTraits.description: Scaling of the legend. For example, a high DPI legend may have scaling = 0.5, so it will be scaled down 50%

LegendTraits.name: urlMimeType
LegendTraits.description: The MIME type of the URL legend image. For example "image/png"

LegendTraits.name: backgroundColor
LegendTraits.description: Apply background color to entire legend. This can be useful if legend is transparent and clashes with Terria colours. This will override legendBackgroundColor.

LegendItemTraits.name: title
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleTitles
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple titles to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: maxMultipleTitlesShowed
LegendItemTraits.description: Maximum number of multiple titles to display next to this legend item. (Default is 10)

LegendItemTraits.name: titleAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display above this legend item, i.e. marking the top of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: titleBelow
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display below this legend item, i.e. marking the bottom of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: color
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color to display for this item. This property is ignored if Legend URL is specified.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineColor
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color with which to outline this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of outline in pixels

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineStyle
LegendItemTraits.description: The style of outline using CSS outline-style values. Eg 'dotted', 'dashed', 'solid', 'double', 'groove', 'ridge', 'inset', 'outset'

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleColors
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple colors to show with this item in a grid arrangement.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageUrl
LegendItemTraits.description: The URL of an image to display with this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: marker
LegendItemTraits.description: Maki marker ID to display with this item (eg "circle").

LegendItemTraits.name: rotation
LegendItemTraits.description: The degrees to rotate legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: addSpacingAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: True to add a bit of extra spacing above this item in order to separate it visually from the rest of the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageHeight
LegendItemTraits.description: The height of the legend image.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of the legend image.
